column1: # TITLE: Plasma lncRNA and mRNA profiles in patients with NSCLC: Pre-operation vs. post-operation

# SUMMARY: Circulating transcriptional landscapes between pre-operation and post-operation plasma samples were compared using the Arraystar Human LncRNA Microarray V4 with probes for profiling of 40173 human lncRNAs and 20730mRNAs. Goal was to investigate the impact of tumor removal on circulating lncRNA and mRNA expression levels.
